name: Detritus (dissolved and particulate organic matter)
description: Non-living organic matter of the estuary: dissolved organic carbon plus suspended and bottom-sediment particles of dead plankton, faeces and decaying plant material. Functional group pooling the source's three non-living compartments (dissolved organic nutrient, suspended particulate nutrient, sediment particulate nutrient); the sediment pool dominates. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the sum of the three pools, annual mean in mgC/m2.
